summary: Twelve moves still fire one projectile after their first projectile-count upgrade in this build. The card wording is shown as it appears in the game; the notes below explain the current behavior. The proposed fix has not been merged.

groups.note: The first +1 projectile upgrade still leaves one projectile per cast in this build. It does not produce two. Later upgrades and evolution have separate effects.
The +1 projectile part still leaves one projectile per cast in this build. The additional bounce is a separate effect; this does not mean the whole upgrade does nothing.
